name: Saumarez Homestead
scope: October 2014 exterior of the principal Saumarez Homestead house near Armidale, New South Wales. Includes the projecting brick gables, green corrugated roofs, chimneys, two-storey verandas, ironwork and attached service ranges.

originalReview.notes: The main brick house has pale two-tier verandas, green corrugated gables, bracketed paired upper windows, projecting brick bays and a partially glazed upper veranda.

review.method: Exact published Qualla original with pinned Commons hash and creator CC0 dedication
review.notes: The exact Qualla original is reused from its Armidale media family and published in the Saumarez story. It matches the native file hash and Damien Linnane’s own CC0 dedication.
